source.scope: Historical R28B exact registered arrays, 2 calibration and 4 evaluation groups, 512 injected positives and 512 controls. Development only.

kenshi.scope: Exact original implementation for serialized lease/event tests

gladius.scope: TailGEX inspiration; score-tail density per candidate count, not SHA mining or calibrated confidence

anchor.scope: Disjoint task IDs instead of heuristic lane avoidance

core2.scope: Priority/sector service analogue, no game or RF telemetry as evidence

fundamentum.cost_warning: 1.96x median aggregate work; require total CPU accounting

bank.smooth: R35B exact bank with rounded quadratic and sinusoidal templates; isolated exact two-bank maximum, not ODONTO DP replacement
bank.tie: lowest canonical per-bank template id then start bin
bank.precision: float64 exact same left-to-right 16-sample sum /4; strict safe upper bound slack 1e-10*(1+16*maxabs)

calibration.rank: Fit-only tail count / valid start-bin count, stable id tiebreak. No test labels or adaptation.

measurement.scope: same-process CPU kernels, wall and process CPU seconds, peak process RSS, candidate paths, actual row reads plus bound overhead, cache/communication bookkeeping. Serial vs threaded same bank, no end-to-end speed claim.
measurement.core_priority: Label-free max absolute/input row peak proxy per chunk; all jobs completed; report priority completion latency vs FIFO, not recall improvement.
measurement.fault: Inject worker exception after one half-chunk task is computed but before commit; lease expiry and reassign to Anchor; count wasted work, reject stale or duplicate commit, confirm exact output and full coverage.

gate: A-E exact scores and witnesses, closed task coverage and no lost results. Performance admission only if end-to-end CPU and wall reductions; preserve full R28 and HANNAH. R36F full swarm vs native methods blocked until R35G/R35H and new independent groups; historical two-bank metrics descriptive only.
